home.title: Web, Mobile & Custom Software Solutions
home.description: We take your business to the digital future with modern software solutions. Web, mobile and enterprise software development.

hero.headline: We build custom software and web solutions that digitalize your business processes.
hero.body: From corporate websites to management panels, from appointment systems to custom business software, we design, launch, and provide ongoing technical support for digital systems built around your needs.
hero.microcopy: A free 15-minute discovery call to define the exact needs and scope of your project.

businessTool.heading: Your website shouldn't just look good. It should work for your business.
businessTool.body: At Arillasoft, we don't treat a website as a separate showcase — we treat it as the starting point of your business's digital systems. From a visitor finding you, to booking an appointment, to making a payment, to receiving automatic updates, we plan the whole structure as one connected system.

concepts.title: Get Found
concepts.description: Strengthen your visibility in search engines and AI-powered answer systems with SEO and GEO foundations.

concepts.title: Convert
concepts.description: Turn visitors into real actions — forms, appointments, reservations, orders, or payments.

concepts.title: Connect
concepts.description: Integrate your website with payments, shipping, WhatsApp Business, and other services.

concepts.title: Manage
concepts.description: Manage customer, order, appointment, or operational data through panels built for your business.

webCommerce.heading: We build a strong foundation for your digital presence.
webCommerce.body: We develop fast, manageable, growth-ready web solutions — from corporate websites to e-commerce platforms. Alongside design, we treat performance, technical infrastructure, measurement, and conversion as core parts of every project.

solutions.title: Corporate Websites
solutions.description: Fast, easily manageable corporate websites that tell your brand's story correctly.

solutions.title: E-Commerce
solutions.description: Sales-ready e-commerce systems — from product management to payment infrastructure, order flow to shipping integration.

solutions.title: Web Applications
solutions.description: Web applications that go beyond a standard website — user accounts, dashboards, transaction screens, and custom functionality.

solutions.title: Landing Pages
solutions.description: Conversion-focused, measurable landing pages for campaigns, products, or services.

businessSystems.heading: We also build the business systems running behind your website.
businessSystems.body: Every business works differently. When off-the-shelf software isn't enough, we build custom systems around your appointment, reservation, customer management, order, or operational processes.

capabilities.title: Appointment Systems
capabilities.description: Customers see available times and book instantly; your business manages the whole process from a central panel.

capabilities.title: Reservation Systems
capabilities.description: Reservation flows customizable for hotels, restaurants, or service businesses.

capabilities.title: Customer Management
capabilities.description: Customer records, transaction history, and related data managed in one place.

capabilities.title: Admin Panels
capabilities.description: Custom panels for controlling your content, users, orders, or operational data.

capabilities.title: Dashboards
capabilities.description: Interfaces that let a business track its key metrics and processes on a single screen.

capabilities.title: Custom Workflows
capabilities.description: Systems built around how your business actually works, for processes off-the-shelf products don't fit.

businessSystems.highlight: We fit the software to your business — not your business to the software.

industrySolutions.heading: Every business's website doesn't have to do the same job.
industrySolutions.body: We shape the digital infrastructure around the real needs of your industry and operations.

sectors.label: Clinic
sectors.title: One flow, from search visibility to appointment.
sectors.description: Patients find you in search, review your services, and book an appointment directly by picking a suitable time.

sectors.label: Hotel
sectors.title: Connect the guest experience from your website to your management.
sectors.description: We can design your hotel's digital showcase alongside reservations and customer processes as one connected system, instead of separate ones.

sectors.label: Restaurant / Café
sectors.title: Digitize everything from your menu to the customer experience.
sectors.description: Instead of reprinting menus for every change, update products and prices from a central panel.

sectors.label: E-Commerce
sectors.title: A connected sales infrastructure, from order to delivery.
sectors.description: We can build a system where the sale doesn't end at checkout — order and customer communication continue automatically.

automation.heading: Connect your systems. Automate repetitive work.
automation.body: We connect your website or business software with the other services you use, so manual data entry drops and customers get the right information at the right time.
automation.example: For example, when an e-commerce order is handed to a courier, the system can detect it and automatically notify the customer via WhatsApp Business.

growthFoundation.heading: Publishing is the start. Being found and growing is what follows.
growthFoundation.body: A good website shouldn't just work — it should be found quickly, load quickly, and learn from how people use it. That's why we address technical visibility and performance from the start of development.

items.title: SEO
items.description: The technical foundation, content structure, and core optimizations search engines need to understand your site correctly.

items.title: GEO
items.description: Content and technical structure that help AI-powered search and answer systems understand your content clearly and accurately.

items.title: Performance
items.description: Technical performance improvements affecting page load times, Core Web Vitals, and real user experience.

items.title: Analytics
items.description: The analytics foundation for measuring how users interact with your site and grounding decisions in data.

howWeWork.heading: We don't start building before we understand the need.
howWeWork.body: We don't see a project as just a set of screens to deliver. We first understand the business's problem and goal, then shape the digital system together.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.description: We work to understand your business, your target audience, your current processes, and the problem that needs solving.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: We define the project's scope, required features, user flows, and technical approach.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We bring together brand, content, and user experience to design the interface and interactions.

steps.title: Development
steps.description: We build the website, the required backend systems, and integrations with a focus on performance and maintainability.

steps.title: Launch & Grow
steps.description: We launch the system, run the necessary checks, and keep improving it based on your needs.

faq.heading: What you should know before we start.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: It depends on the project's scope. For corporate web projects, design, development, and launch follow the plan set at project kickoff.

items.question: Can you redesign our existing website?
items.answer: Yes. We can analyze your current infrastructure, content, and technical state to build either a full redesign or a controlled modernization plan.

items.question: Can we just get a website built?
items.answer: Yes. Appointment systems, automation, or custom software are not required. Project scope is defined by the business's actual needs.

items.question: Can you build custom software for our business?
items.answer: Yes. Where off-the-shelf solutions fall short, we can build custom admin panels, appointment systems, customer management, and similar web-based systems as needed.

items.question: Is SEO work included?
items.answer: Core technical SEO can be addressed during development. More extensive SEO and GEO work is planned separately based on project scope.

items.question: How does the WhatsApp Business integration work?
items.answer: System events like appointments, orders, or shipping can be connected to WhatsApp Business messaging flows. Integration scope depends on the systems in use.

items.question: Do you provide support after the project?
items.answer: After launch, we can set up an ongoing support model for maintenance, technical support, and new development based on your needs.

finalCta.heading: Let's talk about what we can build for your business.
finalCta.body: Tell us what you need. Let's define the right scope together — from your website to business systems and integrations.
